why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Oneil Cruz is slot #2 (4.574 expected team runs/game).
Slots #2, #3, #7, #1, #6, #8, #5, #4, #9 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #1 ranks 4 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.001 R/G.
Slot #2 yields 4.58 expected PA/game vs 4.70 at primary slot #1. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
